title: Tamil Nadu Governor Arlekar, CM Vijay express condolences over passing of music director Deva
content: In a statement on social media, CM Vijay said State honours will be accorded to the music director during his funeral

title: Andhra Pradesh RTI Commission earns national recognition for speedy case disposal
content: The Commission has disposed of 7,034 cases between January and September 2026, compared with 3,252 cases in 2024 and 3,326 in 2025, says State Chief Information Commissioner Vajja Srinivasa Rao

title: Constable carries woman’s body for a kilometre after retrieving it from river
content: The constable with Mantrayalam police found the body of a woman who allegedly ended her life in the Tungabhadra river floating in the waters, carried it on his back for nearly a kilometre through hilly terrain, before reaching the shore

title: Justice Nagarathna flags gaps in implementation of Juvenile Justice Act at National Annual Stakeholders Consultation
content: Justice Nagarathna said the focus should not be limited to disposing of cases. The system must also ensure that children receive education, counselling, medical care and legal assistance while their cases are pending.

title: Over 3.85 lakh cases pending in 28 information commissions as of June 2026: report
content: The ‘Report Card on the Performance of Information Commissions in India, 2025-26’ says the number of appeals and complaints pending on June 30, 2026, in 28 information commissions stood at 3,85,716; in 2025, it was 4,13,972

title: Police fire six rounds in air to defuse tension in Pulivendula
content: Trouble breaks out as YSRCP activists attempt to barge into the nomination filing centre in large numbers; police resort to mild lathi-charge to chase away trouble-mongers; Kadapa MP Avinash Reddy accuses Chief Minister and HRD Minister of ‘instigating attacks’

title: ANU under fire over contract faculty evaluating distance-education answer scripts
content: Allegations surface that the college has engaged contractual faculty members working at the postgraduate level at ANU instead of employing eligible degree-level teaching faculty to evaluate the answer scripts

title: Former security guard arrested for murder of five-year-old girl in Kowkoor over ₹20 lakh ransom
content: Residents of the gated community gathered at the Malkajgiri Police Commissioner’s camp office in Begumpet, raising concerns over children’s safety while parents are away at work.

title: Durga Puja sets stage for community outreach by businesses in West Bengal
content: Idols made from recycled pens, discarded machine parts, and packaged food; health scans, pandal-hopping trips, resting kiosks, and responsible consumption — corporate branding blends into the iconic celebrations

title: Four including a toddler die after electric car hits wall and catches fire on Vijayawada West bypass
content: Three-year-old boy is among the deceased; victims were returning after attending a function when the accident occurred

title: Karnataka Chief Minister announces funds for Mekedatu project in next Budget
content: A committee headed by the Deputy Commissioner has been constituted to make arrangements to provide alternative land for the 5,000 hectares belonging to the Forest Department that will be submerged due to the project

title: The caste thread travels overseas
content: Dalit students studying abroad hope to escape oppressive caste hierarchies, only to find that the dominant-caste diaspora has exported its prejudice into classrooms and social settings across borders, reports Radheshyam Jadhav

title: MPSC paper leak case: Mumbai Crime Branch arrests another accused
content: The case relates to the alleged leak of the question paper for the MPSC Drug Inspector (Group B) recruitment examination held in March 2026

title: Tirumala Navaratri Brahmotsavams begin with Tiruchi procession, Pedda Sesha Vahanam seva
content: Lord Malayappa Swamy, accompanied by Sridevi and Bhudevi, blesses devotees along the four mada streets; new ceremonial umbrellas offered to the temple

title: BJP chief accepts Minister’s challenge on SIR
content: The BJP leader also launched a sharp attack on Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy, accusing him of using references to Hindu deities for political gains

title: Sri Sathya Sai district wins PMDDKY award for farm credit excellence, agriculture promotion
content: The district excelled in disbursing bank loans to farmers on time, providing loans to 3,69,970 farmers worth ₹4,992 crore, ensuring investment support, hassle-free cultivation, and financial empowerment that led to quality crop production and economic development

title: GE to double India sourcing to $400 mn by 2030; GE-CFM engines set to power 9 in 10 aircraft
content: GE Aerospace’s plans to increase sourcing and deepen its engineering capabilities could further integrate Indian suppliers into global aerospace manufacturing while supporting the growing demand for engine maintenance and servicing.

title: 'Arbitrary, unreasonable’: Actor Imran Khan moves HC to challenge 'leave India' notice
content: Imran Khan Pal filed a petition against a notice mandating his departure from India by October 28. He claims the notice violates his fundamental rights under the Indian Constitution and lacks justification. Khan argues that he has lived in India since he was two years old and is an Overseas Citizen of India. The notice was issued following his attendance at a protest, leading to claims of arbitrary detention.

title: 'Can't die like this': Indian pilot Smit Machchhar recalls flydubai flight ordeal
content: In a shocking incident on September 30, Indian Captain Smit Machchhar endured an assault by his Omani co-pilot aboard flydubai flight FZ1073 en route from Dubai to Tel Aviv. With injury and determination, Machchhar opened the cockpit door, allowing passengers to step in and restrain the assailant. The aircraft landed safely in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, following a critical altitude drop.

title: 'How it feels': Dipke shares cheeky SRK post after walking out of jail
content: Abhijeet Dipke was granted bail on certain conditions on Saturday, less than 24 hours after Delhi Police took him into preventive custody over his planned 'Tiranga Yatra' in Connaught Place (CP). Dipke was detained shortly after leaving the residence of NCP-SCP spokesperson Anish Gawande, where he had been staying, to attend the planned flag march in Connaught Place.

title: 'Can't believe he's not first choice': Clarke slams India over Kuldeep snub
content: The recent decision by India to omit Kuldeep Yadav from the T20I squad has ignited discussions among cricket analysts. Experts like Michael Clarke emphasize that Kuldeep's knack for claiming wickets is invaluable in T20 matches. Meanwhile, Naman Dhir has adequately taken on the role of the second spinner. Nevertheless, Kuldeep's past performances against the West Indies, along with his extensive experience, raise important questions about India's future selection policies.

title: How Satya Nadella transformed Microsoft’s culture with three simple words
content: Satya Nadella transformed Microsoft's culture by promoting a growth mindset and continuous learning among employees. This approach encouraged curiosity and adaptation during periods of technological change. As Microsoft adapts to advancements in artificial intelligence, Nadella highlighted the importance of unlearning and learning in maintaining relevance. The company's mission is shifting towards empowering users to develop their own solutions with integrated AI.

title: Vaidehi Chandrasekar, 72, wins global nature photography gold for giraffe shot
content: Vaidehi Chandrasekar captured a stunning photograph titled 'Water Ballet,' showcasing a giraffe gracefully drinking water in Botswana. The imagery beautifully illustrates the giraffe's fluid movements, enhanced by the shimmering sunlight on the water's surface. Since retiring in 2019, Chandrasekar has dedicated her passion to wildlife photography, striving to promote conservation efforts through her award-winning work, including a prestigious gold award at the 2026 World Nature Photography Awards.

title: 'I love you' on clothes & a chilling note: What preceded Gurgaon techie couple's deaths
content: An IT professional, Mohammad Aslam, and his wife, Farhana, were discovered dead in their Gurgaon apartment. Aslam sent an alarming email to his employer before the incident, indicating a distressing situation. Police suspect that Aslam may have killed his wife before taking his own life. Relatives claim that Aslam had been struggling with depression for about 18 months prior to the tragedy.

title: Over 1,000 residents oppose A$15bn data centre planned near Wagga Wagga
content: A proposed A$15 billion data-centre campus near Wagga Wagga has ignited a heated community conversation. Local residents express concerns about the impact on agricultural land, increased energy requirements, and ripple effects on the environment. Conversely, advocates highlight the prospects of enhanced economic growth and job opportunities for the area. The state government will assess these implications before making a final decision, with residents urging thorough evaluations to address their worries.

title: Reese Witherspoon buys back Hello Sunshine five years after $900m deal
content: Reese Witherspoon's recent collaboration with Mediawan to reacquire Hello Sunshine from Candle Media marks a pivotal moment in the entertainment sector. This transaction underscores rising transformations in valuation methods, as Hello Sunshine had previously commanded a valuation surpassing $900 million. With an ambition to enhance its narrative quality and global presence, Witherspoon is dedicated to guiding the company's creative trajectory and upcoming projects.

title: USCIS: Anyone who ‘guarantees’ a faster visa or Green Card is scamming you
content: USCIS warns immigrants and visa applicants about fraudulent schemes that promise quicker visa approvals in exchange for monetary fees. These scams frequently involve false claims of having special ties to government officials. USCIS insists that no one can hasten the immigration process through personal connections. Individuals should file applications independently and trust assistance only from recognized professionals. Recognizing fraudulent emails and suspicious offers is essential to protect against these scams.

title: Brad Paisley and wife help open free Nashville grocery store with $1m gift
content: Brad Paisley and Kimberly Williams-Paisley have expanded their philanthropic efforts by launching a second location of The Store, a nonprofit grocery aimed at combating food insecurity in Nashville. Following their first store's success in 2020, which garnered over 3,100 dedicated volunteers, the couple has invested $1 million into this new initiative to ensure families receive dignified access to food choices and additional resources.

title: TDP, YSRCP clash during Andhra poll nominations; police fire 6 rounds in Jagan’s turf
content: Violent confrontations broke out between TDP and YSRCP activists in Kadapa during the nominations filing phase. Police had to intervene in Pulivendula when YSRCP supporters tried to rush the nominations centre. Clashes also occurred in places like Mydukur and Rayachoti, resulting in injuries among party workers. Several YSRCP leaders were placed under house arrest due to these escalating tensions.

title: Madras HC: Covid ‘destroyed’ marriage, pandemic disputes need separate treatment
content: The court directed district judges in Tamil Nadu to collect data from family courts dealing with matrimonial disputes pertaining to those marriages which had taken place between 2020 to 2022.

title: Brittany Mahomes reacts to Kylie Kelce's heartfelt praise with two words
content: Kylie Kelce publicly praised Brittany Mahomes for her role in promoting women's soccer in Kansas City. Brittany is a co-owner of the Kansas City Current, contributing to the growth of women's sports. Her athletic background includes playing college soccer and founding Brittany Lynne Fitness. The establishment of CPKC Stadium highlights the investment in women's soccer in the area. Brittany's work emphasizes her individual identity beyond being an NFL player's wife.

title: 'An evening in Paris': Opposition questions 'nature' of Punjab CM Mann's France visit
content: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann's trip to Paris has triggered criticism from opposition leaders and parties. Concerns have been raised regarding drug abuse, law and order, and recent violent incidents in the state. Critics question the appropriateness of Mann's foreign visit, especially as he celebrated his birthday during a crisis. Allegations suggest that he attended a police meeting under the influence of alcohol, which raises further concerns.

title: Watch: Masked French protesters briefly storm Marseille city hall
content: Protesters briefly occupied the lobby of Marseille city hall to voice their discontent over rising fuel costs. They shouted revolutionary slogans while some vandalized property within the building. Law enforcement later dispersed the crowd, which resulted in several violent clashes. Tens of thousands are expected to demonstrate nationwide against the increasing cost of living and perceived inequality.

title: Hope for history: WI skipper eyes Salt, Babar's world records in 5th T20I vs India
content: Hope scored an unbeaten century in the fourth T20I on Wednesday (October 14) and has made 261 runs across the four matches so far.

title: Stalin challenges Rahul's SIR credit claim with Bihar, Soren reminder
content: MK Stalin endorsed protests against the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls and criticized Congress for its inconsistent positions. During a DMK Parliamentary Party meeting, four resolutions were adopted, including the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. The DMK emphasized its early opposition to the SIR process and questioned Congress's credibility on the issue. Resolutions included support for student protests and criticism of local party leaders’ silence.

title: 'Drishyam 3' box office Day 16 : Ajay Devgn starrer set to cross Rs 350 crore net
content: Ajay Devgn's much-anticipated film, 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion,' has seen remarkable success at the box office, amassing over Rs 338.41 crore in India since its release. The film, directed by Abhishek Pathak and featuring a stellar cast including Ajay Devgn and Tabu, has garnered admiration from audiences and critics alike. Mohanlal has also publicly lauded the Hindi adaptation, further enhancing its appeal across theaters nationwide.

title: Malayalam filmmaker Belraj Kalarickal dies at 27
content: Belraj Kalarickal, a Malayalam filmmaker, recently died at the age of 27, possibly from a heart attack. He was discovered in a hotel room in Kochi, to the shock of his colleagues. Belraj had recently made his directorial debut with the web series 'Kappi Squad' just days before his death. He was a founding member of First Print Studios, contributing significantly to its projects.

title: Patna man gets 2 yrs’ RI for triple talaq; acquitted of acid attack charge
content: A Patna court has sentenced Naushad Ahmed to two years of rigorous imprisonment for pronouncing triple talaq. This case marks the first conviction under the Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act in Patna district. While Ahmed was acquitted of attempting to throw acid on his wife, he has been charged with other offenses. His lawyer indicated plans to challenge the verdict in the high court soon.

title: ‘Hands tied, mouth taped’: Gurgaon man finds wife murdered in loo
content: A 34-year-old woman named Neetu was discovered murdered in her home in Daulah village. Her husband, Prashant, found her body in the bathroom with injuries and signs of struggle. Police are investigating all angles, including potential theft, while the motive remains unclear. Forensic teams have collected evidence, and CCTV footage is being examined. A murder case against unidentified persons will be registered based on family statements.

title: Why Trump's plan to unleash 'Mother Of All Bombs' may fall flat in Iran
content: Military discussions are considering the use of the MOAB against Iran's nuclear facilities and military targets. However, the effectiveness of the MOAB is limited against deeply buried sites protected by reinforced concrete. Analysts highlight that the GBU-57 penetrator is better suited for such underground facilities, which require specialized weapons for effective targeting. While the MOAB has a strong psychological impact, its military utility against hardened targets is questionable.

title: ‘JD wanted to chat real quick’: How Trump’s press secy was fired mid-interview
content: Katie Zacharia's brief tenure as White House press secretary ended abruptly after just five days due to a rocky start marked by an underwhelming briefing and questions regarding her qualifications. Despite Donald Trump's warning to reconsider the role, she was determined to fulfill her duties to the president and the nation. Her departure leaves the press office in limbo, especially with midterm elections approaching.

title: Australian cricketer slams 14-ball fifty, misses Sooryavanshi's world record
content: Jake Fraser-McGurk made history by scoring the fastest half-century in One-Day Cup history. His incredible innings of 122 runs off just 63 balls, supported by Nathan McSweeney's 106, propelled South Australia to a formidable total of 397/7 against Queensland. With a striking display featuring ten fours and nine sixes, Fraser-McGurk's talent shone brightly at the Karen Rolton Oval.

title: HDFC deputy MD Kaizad Bharucha announces exit ahead of Anup Bagchi's takeover as CEO
content: HDFC Bank's Deputy Managing Director, Kaizad Bharucha, has announced his resignation, effective December 31. This move precedes Anup Bagchi's appointment as the new Managing Director and CEO. In the latest reports, HDFC Bank has demonstrated remarkable profitability shifts this July to September, reflecting improved asset quality and a surge in net profit. Bharucha's resignation awaits approval from the Reserve Bank of India, as it has been accepted by the board.

title: Iran unable to fund 'proxy militia'; lost $25b in oil exports to naval blockade: US
content: The United States has asserted that Iran faces significant financial challenges due to a naval blockade. This blockade has reportedly restricted Iran's import and export capabilities, particularly affecting oil. Additionally, the US claims that Iran has suffered substantial losses, estimated at $25 billion, due to this blockade. Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps recently reported an incident involving a supertanker in the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Congress alleges RSS-BJP agenda behind Census 2027 changes
content: The Congress party on Saturday expressed alarm over the BJP-led government's decision to broaden the pool of eligible enumerators for Census 2027, prompting the inclusion of teachers from various educational institutions as census officers. Congress general secretary Jairam Ramesh has argued that this change jeopardizes the integrity of the census.

title: Pope Leo XIV to be discharged from hospital after successful lung cancer surgery today
content: Pope Leo XIV is set to leave the hospital after a successful lung cancer surgery, demonstrating commendable recovery progress. He engaged positively with his senior aides, expressing heartfelt gratitude towards the medical team for their dedicated care. As doctors await crucial test results to plan further treatment, the pontiff's upcoming trip to Latin America from November 6 to 17 highlights his determination to fulfill his commitments.

title: You earn, save and invest. But are you financially literate? 10 questions to ask
content: Financial literacy encompasses understanding one's income, expenses, and the risks associated with investments. Differentiating between saving and investing is crucial for effective financial planning. Individuals must be vigilant against financial fraud and misleading guidance in their investment choices. A well-structured financial plan aids in aligning savings and investments with personal objectives. Familiarity with financial concepts empowers individuals to make thoughtful decisions and manage their finances responsibly.

title: 'A fundamental right': Supreme Court refuses internet ban for children
content: The Supreme Court has declared that internet access is a fundamental right applicable to all, including children. This decision reinforces the significance of achieving a balance between safety and individual freedoms online for minors. Moreover, the court advocates for enhancements in identifying harmful content. This landmark ruling builds upon earlier verdicts that recognized digital access as a constitutional entitlement.

title: 10 charred to death in fire at seaside resort in Bangladesh
content: At least 10 people were killed and nine injured after a fire gutted a three-storey seaside resort in Bangladesh’s Cox’s Bazar district early Saturday, The Express Tribune reported. The blaze broke out around 6.30am at TUPTUP Resto and Resort, built mainly of bamboo and wood. The cause remains unknown, while several people’s whereabouts were unclear. Injured victims were taken to hospital.

title: CJI flags ‘external forces’ that threatened to disrupt NLSIU convocation
content: At the NLSIU convocation ceremony in Bengaluru, Chief Justice Surya Kant acknowledged external challenges that threatened the event, inspiring graduates to champion legal principles with unwavering integrity. Deputy chief minister DK Shivakumar reinforced the notion of law as a civic duty, sharing plans to bolster the state's legal system. Students were proudly awarded their degrees, marking the start of their professional journeys in the legal field.

title: 'Arrogant and cocky': De Villiers on why Virat Kohli seemed 'overly confident'
content: AB de Villiers initially viewed Virat Kohli as someone who exuded an air of arrogance and cockiness in their first encounters. Kohli's early confidence, evident even as a young player, was frequently misread by many. However, as time passed, De Villiers observed a remarkable evolution in Kohli, leading to a more balanced demeanor.

title: Imran Khan facing Nawaz, Benazir-style exile deal? Pak oppn leader's big claim
content: Pakistan opposition Mahmood Khan Achakzai has raised concerns that Imran Khan might be coerced into negotiating an exile agreement, drawing parallels to the previous exiles of Nawaz Sharif and Benazir Bhutto. He noted that opposition parties are joining forces to tackle pressing political issues. Additionally, Achakzai criticized the current limitations on prisoner meetings and advocated for stronger parliamentary actions. Moreover, opposition leaders have legally contested the governor's rule imposed in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

title: 'Legal Profession Is Not For Faint Of Heart': Chief Justice To Law Graduates
content: Addressing the 34th annual convocation of the National Law School of India University (NLSIU) here, he said legal education must go beyond academic learning and prepare students to engage with diverse perspectives and serve society.

title: Why CJP's Abhijeet Dipke Walked Free While Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka Remain In Jail
content: Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka were sent to 5-day judicial custody for entering Jantar Mantar despite police orders and trying to disturb the peace; Abhijeet Dipke was released because of a key difference, sources told NDTV.

title: White House Set Up Press Secretary For Brutal TV Grilling Before Firing: Report
content: According to a report by The Telegraph, US President Donald Trump's most senior aide, Susie Wiles helped set up the news interview as a "sanctioned hit" because Zacharia was not her preferred choice to replace Karoline Leavitt.

title: Opinion: Opinion | Slurs, Threats, Now A Temple Attack Plot: When Did America Become So Hostile To Indians?
content: The rising tide of anti-India, anti-Hindu, and racist attacks serves as a stark reminder that economic prosperity does not automatically guarantee social immunity from bigotry.

title: Abhijeet Dipke Released After Signing 'Peace Bond' On Court Orders
content: He was detained on Friday and then formally arrested as he planned to head to Connaught Place for a 'Tiranga March' to gather and wave the national flag as part of ongoing protests against alleged electoral fraud.

title: UDP Down To 4 In Meghalaya As Speaker Recognises 8 MLAs' Switch To BJP
content: The eight legislators are Lahkmen Rymbui, Pius Marwein, Kyrmen Shylla, Mayralborn Syiem, Matthew Beyondstar Kurbah, Ollan Singh Suin, Balajied Kupar Synrem and Synshar Kupar Roy Lyngdoh Thabah.

title: "Will Be Crushed Under Weight Of Power": Pak Opposition Leader Warns Military
content: Addressing a public gathering in Punjab's Multan district on Friday, Rehman said Pakistan could function effectively only when the military, bureaucracy and elected institutions operated within their respective constitutional domains.

title: 'Fake Emails, QR Code': Ahmedabad Police Bust Fake Navratri Pass Scam
content: Unidentified fraudsters created a fake Instagram handle under the username veer.rajjputtt and used a mobile number ending in 808 to impersonate the event organisers.

title: Chat With JD Vance, Then Fired Moments Later: How Katie Zacharia Was Axed'
content: Katie Zacharia did not get off to the best start. Her first press briefing performance was lacklustre. Not only that, questions were raised about Zacharia's background and qualifications.

title: Army Intends To Sack Major Over Alleged Affairs With Wives Of 2 Officers
content: The Army served the officer a show-cause notice on August 10 under Army Rules 19 and 14, asking him to explain why he shouldn't be dismissed from service without a court-martial.

title: Analysis: How Punjab's War Against Drugs Is Being Sabotaged From Within
content: The murder of activist Parvinder Singh Jhota in Mansa has underlined that some chemists are fearlessly selling banned, controlled, and habit-forming pills under the nose of health department officials.

title: Children Among 10 Killed In Bangladesh Beach Resort Fire
content: The blaze erupted in the morning and quickly spread through the three-story wooden resort, he said. Children were among the dead

title: JDU's Anant Singh Claims He Got '9 Killed For Nitish Kumar', Then A 'Lalu' U-Turn
content: Anant Singh, who has been upset with the party for fielding his political rival Neeraj Kumar in the upcoming legislative council polls, made the claim while lashing out at his adversary.

title: Noida Couple, 3 Children Ate Noodles At Night. They Were Found Dead Next Day
content: Police have identified the victims as Mahesh (37), his wife Lalita (35), their sons Laddu (11) and Sakshat (3) and daughter Mishti (7).

title: "Shouldn't Accept": Nvidia CEO Disagrees With OpenAI CEO On AI Incidents
content: Jensen Huang said that recent cybersecurity incidents could have been avoided using better monitoring and containment of AI agents.

title: Bran Meant For Cattle Feed Found In Priyagold Biscuits: Food Regulator
content: FSSAI conducted an inspection of Surya Food & Agro following a consumer complaint. It observed serious food safety and hygiene deficiencies.

title: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee Faces Bailable Warrants In 2018 Defamation Case
content: The development comes days after the court issued fresh summons to Rathee on October 12, noting that the complainant had been trying to serve him for several years.

title: "Will Sit On Dharna": Supreme Court's Quip Over Delayed Road Work Near Delhi High Court
content: The protest remark was made in a lighter vein and was particularly striking at a time when Delhi is witnessing multiple protests over various issues.

title: Wanted Money For Birthday, Bike: 2 Minors Kill Teen Friend For Gold Chain
content: Prajyot Kamble was wearing a gold chain and his two minor friends allegedly hatched a plan to take it. One of them wanted to celebrate his birthday, while the other wanted to buy a bike.

title: Watch: Bird strike damages Emirates aircraft in Delhi, flight delayed
content: flight delayed following bird strike prompted concerns over potential damage . flight was scheduled to depart from Delhi’s Indira Gandhi International Airport . further details about the incident and the extent of any damage to the aircraft are awaited .

title: White House lists over $330 billion investments from India
content: the white house listed investments worth over $10.87 trillion in the u.s., including more than $330 billion from India . the list included two separate entries for India, one showing investments worth $310 billion and another $20.5 billion .

title: Dak Prescott reacts to Jalen Hurts' blood clot scare, urges athletes to speak up
content: dak Prescott has reflected on his health amid his blood clot situation . the star quarterback said he is fortunate to have his physical therapist . he said: 'let me get a better check on it.'

title: Ukraine’s defences against Russia hit by Starlink limits, Kyiv in talks with US
